2124656936084025686.en_summary: @bchesky: That’s another interesting point. There is the skill set of a founder/builder that is just fundamentally different. In industries where innovation and product matter, like tech, having a founder-builder-type as CEO is ideal. For companies where the product doesn’t change (like Hershey’s) I assume it’s less important. In short, in founder-led companies, the CEO is also the head of product.
2124656936084025686.zh_summary: @bchesky：這是另一個有趣的觀點。創辦人/建造者的技能組合根本不同。在創新和產品重要的行業，如科技，擁有創辦人-建造者類型作為CEO是理想的。對於產品不變化的公司（如好時），我假設它較不重要。簡言之，在創辦人領導的公司中，CEO也是產品負責人。
